description: Submit proof of completion for a campaign action — a public URL to a post, a screenshot, a video, or platform-verified data. The submission enters a review queue (or auto-approves depending on the campaign's verification mode).

actionId.description: Specific action being completed (must be allowed by the campaign).

metadata.description: Optional bag of context (poster handle, post timestamp, etc.).

proofType.description: How the proof was captured. 'url' triggers automated verification.

proofUrl.description: Public URL of the proof. For url-type submissions, the platform verifier will fetch this.

name: submitProof
